#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define int long long
#define mod 998244353
#define inf 1e18
#define eps 1e-9
#define pi 3.141592653589793238462

int32_t main() {
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(NULL);

	int n;
	cin >> n;
	int tmp;
	cin >> tmp;
	if(n <= tmp) {
		cout << 0 << endl;
		return 0;
	}
	int k = tmp;
	vector<long long> fact(400001);
	vector<long long> revFact(400001);
	fact[0] = 1;
	for(int i = 1; i <= 400000; i++) {
		fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % mod;
	}
	revFact[400000] = pow(fact[400000], mod-2);
	for(int i = 399999; i >= 0; i--) {
		revFact[i] = (revFact[i+1] * (i+1)) % mod;
	}
	long long ans = 0;
	int si = 1;
	long long t = comb(n, n-k);
	for(int i = n-k; i >= 1; i--) {
		ans = (ans + (si * comb(n-k, i) * pow(i, n))) % mod;
		if(ans < 0) ans += mod;
		si *= -1;
	}
	ans = (ans * t) % mod;
	if(k != 0) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
	if(ans < 0) ans += mod;
	cout << ans << endl;

	return 0;
}

long long comb(int a, int b) {
	if(a < b) return 0;
	return (fact[a] * revFact[b] % mod * revFact[a-b] % mod) % mod;
}

long long pow(long long x, long long y) {
	if(y == 0) return 1;
	if(y % 2 == 1) return (x * pow(x, y-1)) % mod;
	long long root = pow(x, y/2);
	return (root * root) % mod;
}

long long mul(long long x, long long y) {
	return (x * y) % mod;
}

long long div(long long x, long long y) {
	return (x * pow(y, mod-2)) % mod;
}
